snippet.title: Block Witch Prologue | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Witchfolk everywhere! Block out your schedules, brush up on your spellwork and get ready to be… B-Witched! 🔮✨

Block Witch: Prologue is now available on Steam. 

Download now!

Block Witch is a narrative puzzle-adventure game filled with slide-on-ice inspired puzzles, wacky dialogue, magical blocks… so many blocks. 
Place blocks and help Vampirella clear each puzzle as she embarks on a journey to unravel the mysteries of a great magical disturbance.
